question: What dual status of being universally beloved and supreme belongs to Kusumapriyā?
premises: Kusumapriyā is herself beloved of all.
inference: Kusumapriyā simultaneously holds universal belovedness and supreme status.
uncertainties: Whether kusumapriyā functions here primarily as a proper name or as a descriptive epithet.
plain_english: She, Kusumapriyā, is herself beloved of all and also supreme.
